fields.name: pre_press_target
fields.description: Despite its legacy name, store the [y, x] center of the goal-selected demonstration target for the instruction's cube. Read the temporal relation from the goal: for 'right before', select the last completed target placement before the demonstration button press; for 'right after', select the first completed target placement after that press. Remaining on the old target immediately after button contact is not a new placement. Identify completed placements from release and subsequent resting evidence, allowing occlusion; do not substitute a later or final placement. Track the physical target selected by that placement through the entire remaining demonstration to execution start, including target shuffles, exchanges, crossings, occlusion, and small centroid shifts. Store exactly that physical target's reported execution-start center, not the center of whichever target occupies its former position. Resolve identity using the observed motion sequence and joint continuity of moving targets, not spatial rank, target-list order, or proximity to the original placement location. Later placements do not change which target was selected, but subsequent target motion must still be followed. If the selected physical target's identity cannot be resolved, write "unknown". Write this at decision step #1 and retain it unchanged thereafter. If the selected target cannot be identified, write "unknown". e.g. [126, 145]
